title: Something's Wrong With Us
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Nao, a 21-year-old maker of traditional Japanese sweets (wagashi), meets Tsubaki, heir of the prestigious confectioner Kogetsuan, whom she believes framed her mother for his father's murder 15 years earlier (Kodansha blurb). Unrecognized, she enters a marriage arrangement with him to uncover the truth, while his mother and grandfather oppose her (But Why Tho review). Kodansha markets it as a dark, psychological, steamy josei romance.
life_message: Truth and love must be pursued through family secrets and old grudges; craft and perseverance sustain a person.

content.note: Murder mystery at the core; grandfather physically attacks Nao (review); abusive family members (MangaUpdates).
